_readme: Hand-kept entries. Every text field is {en, zh}. Names and codes stay English in both. supplierNotes is keyed by the supplier name in odm.json.

summary.en: The regional hub. Parts wait here until a picklist sends them to an NS.
summary.zh: 區域發貨中心。零件先放在這裡，等 picklist 再出貨給各 NS。

role.en: Receives what the ODMs ship for all NS together, holds it, and sends each NS its share by picklist.
role.zh: 接收 ODM 為所有 NS 一起出的貨，暫存後再依 picklist 分送給各 NS。

value.en: The RO orders the total for all NS; the ODM ships to the hub, which splits it by NS.
value.zh: RO 彙總所有 NS 的需求一起下單；ODM 出貨到 hub，再由 hub 分給各 NS。

value.en: Feili Inventory = open picklists + Stock in HUB. NS + Feili = AAP.
value.zh: Feili Inventory = 未出的 picklist + Stock in HUB；NS + Feili = AAP。

value.en: Held at the cost it came in at; it does not move with exchange rates.
value.zh: 以入庫成本計算，不隨匯率變動。

value.en: PLS_Picklist_Monthly and PLS_Stock_Monthly on the 1st: open picklists and stock in the hub.
value.zh: 每月 1 日的 PLS_Picklist_Monthly 和 PLS_Stock_Monthly：hub 的未出 picklist 與庫存。

summary.en: Acer Group affiliate. From 1 Dec 2026 the parts PAP buys reach the NS through HSN Group; PAP still does the purchasing.
summary.zh: Acer 集團關係企業。2026/12/1 起，PAP 買的零件改經 HSN Group 送到各 NS；採購仍由 PAP 負責。

role.en: Delivers the parts PAP buys to the NS, from 1 Dec 2026.
role.zh: 自 2026/12/1 起，負責把 PAP 買的零件送到各 NS。

value.en: Check how the PO entities change.
value.zh: 先確認 PO 的開立主體如何改變。

summary.en: Australia's service company. ACNZ (New Zealand) sits under ACA.
summary.zh: 澳洲的服務公司。紐西蘭的 ACNZ 隸屬於 ACA。

role.en: Runs Acer's repair service in its country, keeps its parts stock in CSS and orders parts from PAP.
role.zh: 負責所在國家的 Acer 維修服務，在 CSS 管理零件庫存，並向 PAP 訂零件。

summary.en: Taiwan. TW, TWN and TBG all mean Taiwan. Counted in PAP but not in AAP.
summary.zh: 台灣。TW、TWN、TBG 都是指台灣；計入 PAP，但不計入 AAP。

role.en: Runs Acer's repair service in its country, keeps its parts stock in CSS and orders parts from PAP.
role.zh: 負責所在國家的 Acer 維修服務，在 CSS 管理零件庫存，並向 PAP 訂零件。

value.en: Reported in the first week of the month; TPM (third-party repair) is Taiwan only.
value.zh: 每月第一週回報；TPM（第三方維修）只有台灣有。

summary.en: Authorised service centres. They use PLM and CSS; repair cases are recorded in CSS.
summary.zh: 授權維修中心，使用 PLM 和 CSS；維修案件記錄在 CSS。

role.en: Repair Acer products on Acer's behalf and use the parts the NS supply.
role.zh: 代 Acer 維修產品，使用 NS 提供的零件。

notes.en: 2026-11-18: For AAP's extra (Non-FCST) demand of 40 × 27.J1HNG.001 (POWER CORD 1M EU), BMORN confirmed 40 pcs but asked for the PO against 27.DLQNG.001 at USD 2 (system price of J1HNG: USD 1). No substitute chain links the two in the Critical Report.
notes.zh: 2026-11-18：AAP 額外需求（Non-FCST）27.J1HNG.001（POWER CORD 1M EU）40 個，BMORN 確認可供 40 個，但要求 PO 改下 27.DLQNG.001、單價 USD 2（J1HNG 系統價 USD 1）。Critical Report 中兩者沒有替代料關係。

notes.en: LTB shipments follow a 9-month schedule (others: 12 months), partial per RO.
notes.zh: LTB 出貨採 9 個月排程（其他 ODM 為 12 個月），依 RO 分批。

value.en: Sends the Acer DT DR report to every region around the 10th of each month.
value.zh: 每月 10 日左右寄出 Acer DT DR 報表給各區。

value.en: Confirm demand by the 17th; place the PO by the 24th.
value.zh: 17 日前確認需求，24 日前下 PO。
AAP 的 PO 編號格式如 SP010308PAP。

notes.en: 2026-06: LTB called for mainboards (LTB# LT202606160002); Acer replied there was no MB demand. Lengda now has no MB stock left, so MB requests can't be filled (confirmed 2026-08-07).
notes.zh: 2026-06：主機板已做 LTB（LTB# LT202606160002），當時 Acer 回覆 MB 無需求。Lengda 已無 MB 庫存，之後的 MB 需求無法供應（2026-08-07 確認）。

notes.en: 2026-08-14: AAP PO sent after the July DR.
notes.zh: 2026-08-14：依 7 月 DR 寄出 AAP PO。

notes.en: 2026-11: Asked to cut PO SP010308PAP for DK.RF41P.0EK (Primax RF keyboard, DT) from 10 to 6 pcs because their keyboard supply is short. The 18 Nov Critical Report already shows 6 on order.
notes.zh: 2026-11：因鍵盤進料不足，要求把 PO SP010308PAP 的 DK.RF41P.0EK（Primax 無線鍵盤，桌機）從 10 個改為 6 個。11/18 的 Critical Report 在途量已顯示 6。

value.en: Sends HON HAI_OPO_YYYYMMDD to every RO; the 13 November 2026 issue arrived on a Monday. Uses Acer's common OPO template: one row per PO line with status, remaining quantity, ETD, Meet CRD, parts status and shortage reason.
value.zh: 寄 HON HAI_OPO_YYYYMMDD 給各 RO；2026/11/13 這一期在週一寄到。使用 Acer 的共用 OPO 範本：一列一筆 PO line，含狀態、未出貨數量、ETD、Meet CRD、料況與缺料原因。

notes.en: 2026-11-13 OPO: AAP has no open PO lines; all 37 AAP lines are closed (1 cancelled).
notes.zh: 2026-11-13 OPO：AAP 沒有未結的 PO line；37 筆都已結案（另有 1 筆取消）。

value.en: Sends HUNAN GREAT-WALL_OPO_YYYYMMDD to every RO each week, on Friday or the following Monday. Uses Acer's common OPO template: one row per PO line with status, remaining quantity, ETD, Meet CRD, parts status and shortage reason.
value.zh: 每週寄 HUNAN GREAT-WALL_OPO_YYYYMMDD 給各 RO，在週五或隔週一。使用 Acer 的共用 OPO 範本：一列一筆 PO line，含狀態、未出貨數量、ETD、Meet CRD、料況與缺料原因。

notes.en: 2026-11-16 OPO: AAP has 87 open PO lines (2,474 pcs remaining); 85 are overdue against CRD. 60 are in production; by type, 44 TnG-LTB, 38 TnG-Monthly and 5 Special support.
notes.zh: 2026-11-16 OPO：AAP 有 87 筆未結 PO line（未出貨 2,474 件），其中 85 筆已逾 CRD。60 筆生產中；依類型為 TnG-LTB 44、TnG-Monthly 38、Special support 5。

value.en: Sends the Clevo Weekly OPO report (CLEVO CO. _OPO_YYYYMMDD) to every RO, on no fixed weekday; in November 2026 Acer had to ask for the update. Uses Acer's common OPO template: one row per PO line with status, remaining quantity, ETD, Meet CRD, parts status and shortage reason.
value.zh: 寄 Clevo Weekly OPO report（CLEVO CO. _OPO_YYYYMMDD）給各 RO，沒有固定星期；2026 年 11 月曾由 Acer 催更新。使用 Acer 的共用 OPO 範本：一列一筆 PO line，含狀態、未出貨數量、ETD、Meet CRD、料況與缺料原因。

notes.en: 2026-11-17 OPO: AAP has 126 open PO lines (3,009 pcs remaining); 42 are overdue against CRD. 83 are new POs, 26 are in stock waiting to ship and 17 are waiting for production; 123 are TnG-Monthly.
notes.zh: 2026-11-17 OPO：AAP 有 126 筆未結 PO line（未出貨 3,009 件），其中 42 筆已逾 CRD。New PO 83 筆、已入庫待出貨 26 筆、待排產 17 筆；123 筆是 TnG-Monthly。

value.en: Sends the TCL MNT Weekly OPO Report_YYYYMMDD to every RO on Mondays, in its own format: PO lines with status, remaining quantity, ETD and parts status, plus FOC, FCST and B&S sheets.
value.zh: 每週一寄 TCL MNT Weekly OPO Report_YYYYMMDD 給各 RO，使用自己的格式：PO line 的狀態、未出貨數量、ETD 與料況，另有 FOC、FCST、B&S 工作表。

notes.en: 2026-11-16 OPO: AAP has 104 open PO lines (2,851 pcs remaining): 55 in stock, 45 new POs and 4 in production; by type, 57 LTB, 42 FCST-R and 5 Special support.
notes.zh: 2026-11-16 OPO：AAP 有 104 筆未結 PO line（未出貨 2,851 件）：In stock 55、New PO 45、生產中 4；依類型為 LTB 57、FCST-R 42、Special support 5。
